{"id":"fidel-fe3f505cee","am":"The days are ሰኞ (Monday), ማክሰኞ (Tuesday), ረቡዕ (Wednesday), ሐሙስ (Thursday), ዓርብ (Friday), ቅዳሜ (Saturday), and እሑድ (Sunday).
